CardList
The Card list module renders a list of cards as a UI component.
Closing

Cover

Deck
Deck is the organism component that orchestrates slide navigation and theming for a presentation, composing deck-level state into its rendered output.
useDeckNavigation
useDeckNavigation is a hook that manages keyboard and positional navigation state for a deck, tracking which slide is active and exposing helpers to locate photos and slide boxes within it.
DeckFooter
Renders the footer area of a presentation deck.
Flow
Flow module contains a single Flow component with no recorded requirements yet, so its specific purpose cannot be confidently determined beyond its name.
Form
The Form module provides a single UI component for rendering and managing a form.
